data: BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: I want to switch from an Android to Apple phone, what's the easiest way to do that? ASSISTANT:

The easiest way to switch from an Android to an Apple phone is to purchase a new Apple device and transfer your contacts, photos, and other data from your Android device to the new Apple device using a compatible cable and compatible software.

BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: Covid is no worse then the common cold ASSISTANT:

Covid-19 is not the same as the common cold. The common cold is a mild respiratory illness caused by a variety of viruses. Covid-19, on the other hand, is a serious and potentially life-threatening illness caused by the novel coronavirus.
